title: From Symptoms to Systems: An Expert-Guided Approach to Understanding Risks of Generative AI for Eating Disorders

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative abductive analysis of semi-structured interviews with eating disorder experts to identify risks such as fatphobia and the promotion of 'thinspiration', supplemented by illustrative prompt testing on commercial text-to-image AI systems.

Expert interviews identifying how AI models perpetuate demographic stereotypes by portraying eating disorders as conditions that exclusively affect thin, white, Western, female, cisgender, young, and affluent individuals.
